column1: # GitHub Actions workflow counters (.github/workflows/*.yml and composite actions), for a rule with
# the prompt file-body-ops: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line blanks
# comments only: a run: block holds the commands and the secrets a job reads. "steps (approx)" counts
# a list entry that starts with a step key; "secret references" every ${{ secrets.NAME }} occurrence,
# the name of a secret, never its value. OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
